ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High; approximately 75% high-intensity white/light-gray pixels vs 25% low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels on the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity white central zones in both lobes; distinct low-intensity black border along the entire trailing edge; dark mottling concentrated around the median notch area; scattered small low-intensity circular spots located on the interior white field of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 55 degrees; depth is approximately 20% of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary; peak density and sharpness increase significantly at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curvature transitioning to a sharp upward concavity at the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct dark, rounded protrusions and clusters at the distal tips of both lobes; secondary small dark circular spots on the mid-ventral surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular massing and jagged tissue loss at both distal tips; possible minor indentation on the right lobe trailing edge proximal to the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme serration pattern along the trailing edge characterized by deeply incised valleys and sharp peaks.
